_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: net benefit integrated for a calibrated model with logit p = -1.5 + 1.2 X

agreement.claim: both engines report the same net benefits and prevalence
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/agreement_examples.test.py recomputes the truths with scipy quadrature, rebuilds one net benefit from a confusion table, and shows the model beats treat-all at 0.2 and 0.3 in every seed.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: At 0.1 the model's advantage over treat-all (0.013) is inside the tolerance; the check that it beats treat-all is made at 0.2 and 0.3 only. Measured by harness/agreement_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic (owner decisions E5, E6).
